overview_description.description: ThrowMeNot is a UAE-based sustainability e-commerce platform that helps reduce food and product waste by selling near-expiry and surplus products at heavily discounted prices. The company partners with FMCG brands, distributors, and retailers to rescue products that are still usable but close to expiry, overstocked, or undergoing packaging changes.
